review_comments:
So I wrote this comment out with the explanation and I'm now I'm second guessing myself.

The issue is that ultimately the `Chef::Config[:file_cache_path]` gets used everywhere.  We could expect users to wind up trying to put this into shell_out/powershell_out commands and expect it to be rendered correctly into cmd/powershell (or just feeding paths to the file_cache_path into utilities on Windows).  If we have unix-style forward-slashes then we force users to do their own manual cleanpath'ing of this value on windows.

I'm starting to think we should eat the pain of double-backslash escaping the backslashes here...
